purpose: Denylist of npm packages known to add runtime telemetry. CI fails any PR whose `npm ls --all --json` includes a package listed here. Reviewed on every PR. New entries added with rationale.
scope: All deps — direct and transitive. Wildcard patterns (`@sentry/*`) match any package in the scope.
reviewCadence: Every PR. New entries may be added in a dedicated commit with rationale in the entry's `added` and `reason` fields.

packages.reason: Sentry SDKs phone home on every error event by default. Even with `beforeSend` no-ops, the SDK still registers a global error handler and reports session metadata. Blocked at PR time.
packages.alternatives: Self-hosted error logging on the maintainer's workstation (not in this repo's stack).

packages.reason: Fullstory is session-replay telemetry. Always phone home. Always blocked.
packages.alternatives: None — replays are out of scope.

packages.reason: Hotjar is heatmap + session-replay telemetry. Always phone home.
PostHog's browser SDK phones home for analytics and session recording. Even with `opt_out_capturing_by_default` the SDK still loads and registers listeners.
packages.alternatives: None — analytics is out of scope.

packages.reason: Datadog browser RUM and logs SDK. Phones home on every event.
Bugsnag browser SDK. Phones home on every error.
New Relic browser agent. Phones home.
Segment analytics SDK. Phones home on every track() call.
Mixpanel browser SDK. Phones home on every event.
Amplitude analytics SDK. Phones home on every event.
The `googleapis` package itself is not telemetry, but it transitively pulls `google-auth-library` and `gtoken` which phone home for token refresh. Blocked as a precaution.
packages.alternatives: No Google APIs needed for the MVP scope.

packages.reason: Google Cloud client libraries. Auth metadata may be transmitted; the libraries are not designed for zero-network operation.
Firebase client SDK. Always phones home for auth, analytics, and config.
Supabase JS client. Phones home for auth + database over a real-time WebSocket.

axios itself is benign, but the maintainer-shipped telemetry (`XMLHttpRequest` upload-progress events to an analytics endpoint) was added in v1.x and removed in v0.27.x. Blocked as a precaution; if needed in the future, pin to v0.27.x.
Deprecated. Has been known to ship with debug telemetry in older versions.

notes: Pattern matching is glob-style: `@scope/*` matches any package in that scope; bare names match exact package names.
A blocked package that is genuinely needed for MVP scope must be approved in a dedicated PR with rationale in the `alternatives` field, or replaced with a non-blocked alternative.
The denylist is intentionally aggressive — false positives (a blocked package that's actually safe) are cheaper than false negatives (a package that ships telemetry slipping through).
The denylist does not cover build-time dev tooling (Playwright, Vitest, etc.) which legitimately make network calls during install or test runs. The Privacy Baseline covers runtime, not build-time.
